static_traits.name: 梁峰
static_traits.social_status: 有较多朋友，社交支持Good（自述）
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received before；此前not yet出现类似心理问题（自述）
static_traits.language_features: 能清晰表达Loneliness与被拒经历，思路清晰，配合度较高；存在灾难化、非黑即白、过度概括、心理过滤与negate积极等消极自动思维；语速与情绪表现强度Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I have a persistent belief that I will be alone forever, despite having a lot of friends. This belief is causing feelings of loneliness and inadequacy. The problem started around a year ago when I faced several rejections in the dating scene.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these negative thoughts are impacting my emotional well-being and self-esteem.
growth_experiences: 约一年前在相亲/约会中连续遭遇多次拒绝，被描述为“一连串的失败”，此后在Being alone或看到情侣时反复trigger“我会一直Single”的念头；尽管拥有支持性的朋友圈，但因害怕被评判而not yet向朋友倾诉，这些经历逐步Reinforcement了Loneliness与自卑感。

core_beliefs: 我注定会Loneliness/have not人会选择我
我有问题/not够好，not值得被爱

special_situations.event: 夜晚Being alone、思考自己的浪漫not yet来时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果长时间have not人愿意和我约会，就意味着我永远找not到伴侣
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowers expectations by presuming the worst outcome in advance ('it is destined to be so'), to reduce the pain of being rejected again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会一直Single，这已经not可改变了

special_situations.event: 在公共场合看到情侣在一起
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人都有伴侣而我have not，那就说明我not如他们/我not被需要
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Compares self with others and belittles self, avoiding proactive contact to escape further setbacks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: do not人都能拥有亲密关系，只有我not行

special_situations.event: 经历约会/表白被拒之后
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果这次失败了，not yet来也会一直失败；一次拒绝就证明I am not worthy of being loved
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Shifts energy toward confirming the 'destined to fail' thought, reduces attempts to avoid further setbacks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 又被拒了，我永远都找not到人

special_situations.event: 想到要向朋友倾诉Loneliness感与受挫经历时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我暴露脆弱，他们就会看not起我、觉得I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids expressing to friends, keeps feelings bottled up to avoid possible judgment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我很失败，会看not起我

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and to build a stable intimate relationship, to gain love and understanding
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected、被评判为失败者，暴露脆弱后遭到羞辱或negate
defense_goal: Through self-deprecation and presetting 'destined to fail', lowers expectations and avoids the pain of rejection
保持情感防御与not披露，减少外界评判的风险

object_relations.self_representation: 被拒的失败者/not被选择的人
object_relations.object_representation: Others (potential partners/friends) are critical judges and rejecters

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师探询其是否可与朋友分享Loneliness与受挫感时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为一旦表达脆弱，朋友就会看not起自己（像外界评判者一样）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以犹豫、担忧被评判的语气表达顾虑，强调“他们会看not起我”，回避进一步开放性的自我披露。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈及多次被拒的经历与not yet来可能性时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 用“命中注定”来解释失败，以减轻内在冲突与without力感
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use概括性、宿命论的表述（如“可能就是命中注定”），语气带without力感，以此弱化进一步探索具体细节。

manifestations: 看到情侣或在夜晚Being alone时Loneliness感和despair感明显增强
害怕被评判而not向支持性的朋友求助，导致与他人保持情感距离
outcomes: Avoids expressing needs, further weakening connection and support

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 担心被朋友评判为“失败者”，not愿表达Loneliness与求助
在关系中对自我暴露高度谨慎，倾向Repression需求

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 预设朋友会看not起自己、对自己失望，从而避免接触与表达
将内在的羞耻与自贬感Projection为他人会negate自己

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to perform some action toward other people or things, and does it to themselves instead, drawing the energy inward.
manifestations: 有支持性朋友却not寻求支持，把痛苦自我消化
在需要外部帮助时选择忍耐与自我Repression

positive_force: Has a supportive circle of friends; has the ability to maintain friendships
Willing to engage in counseling and try reality testing and cognitive restructuring
能够自我Reflection，识do not恐惧被拒在关系中的作用
negative_force: 灾难化与预测not yet来（“我会一直Single”）
Overgeneralization and black-and-white thinking（一次被拒即等于永远失败）
心理过滤与negate积极，忽视已有的人际连接优势
Afraid of being judged and so avoids expressing needs to friends, reducing available support
自我贬低与宿命论增加without力感与回避行为

target_behavior.behavior: 围绕恋爱前景的灾难化/非黑即白的自动思维（反复自陈“我会一直Single”）
antecedent: 夜晚Being alone时思考not yet来
target_behavior.core_reason: 过去一年连续被拒经历Reinforcement了过度概括与灾难化的认知加工，形成对not yet来关系的negate性核心假设
target_behavior.function: 通过预设最坏结果来避免not确定性与再次被拒的痛苦（情绪负Reinforcement）
target_behavior.consequence: Loneliness与without望感加重，Impaired self-esteem，减少尝试与自我暴露，维持问题循环

target_behavior.behavior: 回避向朋友表达Loneliness与寻求支持
antecedent: 想到要与朋友谈及自己的受挫与Loneliness
Facing strong worry about being rejected or judged
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被评判与羞耻感，伴随读心术式假设“他们会看not起我”
target_behavior.function: 逃避可能的negate性评价与关系受损的担忧（逃避not受欢迎的事物）
target_behavior.consequence: without法获得外部支持与安慰，维持并加重Loneliness与负性信念
